display.purpose: Static ReSource fallback; the animated identity has its own reference-width scale.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared action variant with a visible keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-primary {font-family: "Geist Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); padding: 10px 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s, color .16s; background: var(--brand, #2251ef); color: var(--paper, #fff);} .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {background: #173bc0;} .ds-primary:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-primary:disabled {opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed;}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Shared action variant with a visible keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-secondary {font-family: "Geist Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); padding: 10px 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s, color .16s; background: var(--soft, #e8edf8); color: var(--brand, #2251ef);} .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) {background: #dce4fa;} .ds-secondary:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-secondary:disabled {opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed;}

components.name: Text button
components.description: Shared action variant with a visible keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-text {font-family: "Geist Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); padding: 10px 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s, color .16s; background: transparent; color: var(--brand, #2251ef);} .ds-text:hover:not(:disabled) {background: var(--soft, #e8edf8);} .ds-text:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-text:disabled {opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed;}

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Shared icon-only control; label the action for assistive technology.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Close evidence"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m18 6-12 12M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon {font-family: "Geist Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); padding: 10px 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s, color .16s; min-width: 42px; padding: 10px; color: var(--brand, #2251ef); background: transparent;} .ds-icon:hover {background: var(--soft, #e8edf8);} .ds-icon:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-icon:disabled {opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed;}

components.name: Select field
components.description: Retained workflow select with the v2 shared separator and focus color.
components.css: .ds-field {font-family: "Geist Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #17191d);} .ds-select {font: inherit; color: var(--ink, #17191d); background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d6dbe4); border-radius: 7px; padding: 9px 32px 9px 12px; max-width: 100%;} .ds-select:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;}

components.name: Global navigation
components.description: Cool-paper navigation with a cobalt active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav {display: flex; gap: 28px; height: 72px; background: var(--surface, #f2f3f5); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #d6dbe4);} .ds-nav-item {position: relative; font: 13px "Geist Variable", sans-serif; padding: 0 1px; border: 0; color: var(--muted, #5d6470); background: none; cursor: pointer;} .ds-nav-item.ds-active {color: var(--ink, #17191d);} .ds-nav-item.ds-active:after {content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--brand, #2251ef);} .ds-nav-item:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;}

components.name: Provenance badge
components.description: Compact written provenance; a badge is not a selected part.
components.css: .ds-badge {display: inline-flex; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--soft, #e8edf8); color: var(--brand, #2251ef); padding: 4px 8px; font: 500 11px/1.3 "Geist Variable", sans-serif;}

components.name: Draft panel
components.description: Flat retained document container with v2 corners and native disclosure.
components.html:
Document draft

Review the source-backed fields before approval.
components.css: .ds-draft {background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--ink, #17191d); border-radius: 4px; padding: 24px; font: 14px/1.55 "Geist Variable", sans-serif;} .ds-draft summary {display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 550; cursor: pointer;} .ds-draft summary:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-draft p {margin: 10px 0 0; max-width: 75ch;}

components.name: Selected part row
components.description: A checked, pressed-state selection independent of the 3D renderer.
components.css: .ds-part {display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; text-align: left; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink, #17191d); background: transparent; font: 13px "Geist Variable", sans-serif; cursor: pointer;} .ds-part:hover {background: var(--surface, #f2f3f5);} .ds-part[aria-pressed="true"] {background: #e9eeff; color: #2144ba; border-color: #b7c8ff;} .ds-check {display: grid; place-items: center; width: 15px; height: 15px; border: 1px solid #adb6c7; border-radius: 2px;} .ds-part[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-check {background: var(--brand, #2251ef); border-color: var(--brand, #2251ef); color: white;} .ds-part:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;}

components.name: Selection chip
components.description: Removable selected part with a visible close icon and explicit action label.
components.html: <button class="ds-selection-chip" aria-label="Remove front wheels">Front wheels<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m18 6-12 12M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-selection-chip {display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 11px "Geist Variable", sans-serif; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; background: var(--soft, #e8edf8); color: var(--brand, #2251ef); border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer;} .ds-selection-chip:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #2251ef); outline-offset: 4px;}

narrative.overview:
ReSource uses charcoal lettering, cool near-white work surfaces, electric cobalt actions and selection, and fine dotted geometry. The supplied wordmark establishes the signature: solid Geist lettering resolves into a dotted outline around the pointer, with a restrained vector rig. The working interface carries that precision through thin dividers, compact controls, and prepared physical geometry.

The assembly has depth; the surrounding interface stays flat and legible. Selection is explicit in the model, the part list, and removable chips. Source requirements and unavailable actions remain written beside the relevant controls. The v2 entry and prepared toy-car selection are implemented; the engine demo retains the working intake, evidence, and sourcing flows. The dotted globe and parallel-research frame remain a Figma concept, not a delivered component.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal and cool paper with cobalt reserved for actions, focus, and selection.
Solid-to-dotted ReSource lettering and precise variable Geist typography.
Prepared geometry paired with a persistent, keyboard-operable part list.
Reversible separation with direct controls, reduced motion, and explicit source states.

rules.name: The Explicit State Rule
rules.body: Pair color with a written state, checked selection, or status icon; cobalt selection never means that a requirement is verified.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Geist for headings, prose, controls, and aligned working data. Keep the wordmark’s coordinate readouts local to its vector treatment.

rules.name: The Flat Work Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tone, whitespace, and fine borders for ordinary panels; keep physical lighting and contact shadows within the assembly scene.

dos: Do use cobalt for interactive selection and visible focus while keeping source status written in text.
Do retain the source-required dimensions and material labels beside prepared geometry.
Do keep the model, pressed-state part list, selection count, and removable chips synchronized.
Do provide Assemble, Explode, and the separation slider alongside reversible scroll motion.
Do preserve the engine workflow’s evidence links, provenance labels, status icons, and SIMULATED receipts.
Do use the supplied wordmark as the identity reference and provide its static reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don’t treat curated geometry or a visual group as proof of an engineering requirement.
Don’t present the globe/research concept, toy-car source review, or toy-car supplier research as implemented.
Don’t use cobalt alone to convey selection, compatibility, or approval.
Don’t add decorative card shadows to the flat product workspace.
Don’t turn residual forest-tinted engine styles or 8–10px metadata into v2 defaults.
